videos.script: Most questions people ask of data are about groups. How many books per genre. Total price per author. The newest book of each decade. {{group}} In SQL that is GROUP BY. In a stream it is groupingBy: a function that picks each element's group, and a map from group to the elements in it. {{down}} The interesting part is the second argument. Instead of a list per group, ask for a count, a sum, the titles only, or the dearest book. {{part}} partitioningBy is the special case with two groups, yes and no, and it always returns both, even when one is empty. {{tee}} And last, two collectors run over the same stream at once, combined at the end, so the cheapest and the dearest book come out of one pass.
